profileMessages.steady: UV stays at {uv} across the {coveredDuration} with forecast data, so the average is also {averageUv}.
profileMessages.startEndAverage: Across the forecasted hours, UV starts at {startUv} and ends at {endUv}. The average is {averageUv}.
profileMessages.highest: Highest UV is {uv} for about {duration}, during {periods}.
profileMessages.lowest: Lowest UV is {uv} for about {duration}, during {periods}.
profileMessages.betweenSingle: Other hourly values are {uv} for about {duration} in total.
profileMessages.betweenRange: Other hourly values range from {minimumUv} to {maximumUv} for about {duration} in total.
profileMessages.elevatedAll: UV remains at 3 or higher for the full {coveredDuration} with forecast data.
profileMessages.elevatedPart: UV reaches 3 or higher for about {duration}.
profileMessages.elevatedSeparated: UV reaches 3 or higher in {count} separate stretches, totaling about {duration}.
profileMessages.veryHigh: UV reaches 8 or higher for about {duration}.

actionMessages.protection: At UV 3+, cover exposed skin, wear a broad-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses, and seek shade.
actionMessages.extraProtection: At UV 8+, limit time in direct sun and prioritize shade.
actionMessages.sunscreenBasics: Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously to uncovered skin before the UV 3+ part of your outing.
actionMessages.sunscreenReapplication: If you use sunscreen while outdoors, reapply at least every two hours and sooner after swimming, sweating, or towel drying. Follow the product label.
actionMessages.cloudyElevatedUv: Keep UV protection in place during {periods}, despite heavy cloud cover.
actionMessages.reflectiveConditions: Near snow, bright sand, or water, keep skin and eyes protected even in shade.

lowComplete: UV stays below 3 throughout this outing.
For most people, no extra sun protection is needed during these hours.
lowPartial: UV stays below 3 for the {duration} with forecast data.
For most people, no extra sun protection is needed during those hours.
protection: UV reaches {peakUv} during the {peakTime} hour, with about {duration} at UV 3+.
Use sun protection during those hours.
protectionSeparated: UV reaches {peakUv} during the {peakTime} hour, with about {duration} at UV 3+ in separate periods.
Use sun protection during those hours.
extraProtection: UV peaks at {peakUv} during the {peakTime} hour, with about {veryHighDuration} at UV 8+.
Limit direct sun during the strongest hours and use sun protection.
extraProtectionSeparated: UV peaks at {peakUv} during the {peakTime} hour.
Higher UV comes in separate periods, including about {veryHighDuration} at UV 8+.
Limit direct sun during the strongest hours and use sun protection.

messages.coverageIncomplete: Forecast available for {coveredDuration} of the planned {plannedDuration}. The remaining time has no forecast.
